author: Lunattic13
subject: Error in Renew's and flash heal's growth by level? (Bug/typo, please buff/fix)
content_md:
TLDR: The rank 5 of renew, gained at level 32, is very weak for the level you get it at and disproportionally weak compared to the gain of previous ranks over the last one. The same is true for rank 3 flash heal over rank 2. I am fairly sure both are supposed to be significantly stronger and dread that priest healing is lower than intended because they essentially miss a step of power increase in their spell rank progression.

In-depth: Rank 4 renew heals for 245 at 140 mana cost, while rank 5 heals for 270 at 170 mana cost. This is not a typo; for 30 more mana six or eigth levels after the previous rank, it heals for only 25 more. The spell essentially becomes much more mana inefficient for barely any effect on the numbers. I am fairly sure the healing value is supposed to be around 350-370 as each rank of renew before this one gains at least 50% base power in healing over the last one. Is this a typo, where the value was supposed to be 370 but someone put 270 by mistake?

For the sake of comparison:

Rank 1 renew heals for 45 for 30 mana.
Rank 2 heals for 100 for 65 mana
Rank 3 heals for 175 for 105 mana.
Rank 4 heals for 245 for 140 mana.
Rank 5 heals for 270 for 175 mana.

The same is true for Flash heal:

Rank 1 flash heal heals 202 to 247 for 125 mana.
Rank 2 flash heal heals 269 to 325 for 155 mana.
Rank 3 flash heal heals 278 to 334 for 185 mana.

Looking at this progression, it is very clear that something is wrong with both rank 5 renew and rank 3 flash heal. As stated above, unlike all the other ones, they barely gains in base power over its predecessor. Please fix this and future ranks to bring in in line with intended progression?

Addendum:
To add to this, let's add the other priest instant cast 'heal' as well, power word: shield:

Rank 1: shields for 48 for 45 mana.
Rank 2: shields for 94 for 80 mana.
Rank 3: shields for 166 for 130 mana.
Rank 4: shields for 244 for 175 mana.
Rank 5: Shields for 305 for 210 mana.

Again, unlike rank 5 renew or rank 3 flash heal, this other instant cast spell seems to continue scaling somewhat linearly from rank 4 to 5. I don't see why the priest hot's increase by level is so weak compared to that of power word: shield and assume this is more proof of a typo of sorts being made when programming the healing amount of rank 5 renew or rank 3 flash heal.

content_md:
This is an odd progression indeed, but it's a deliberate change on Turtle made with CC2 from the [1.17.2 patch](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102970#p102970).
> **Dragunovi wrote: Sat Oct 12, 2024 6:28 pm**
> The base healing values for ranks above level 30 and Spell Power scaling for all ranks have been reduced by 15% for the following spells: Lesser Heal, Renew, Heal, Flash Heal, Prayer of Healing, Greater Heal, Desperate Prayer and Lightwell.
>
>  *Developer Comment: This change has been done alongside a buff to Spiritual Healing, the introduction of Swift Recovery and updates to Lightwell making it an useful part of a healer’s toolkit. Most players have felt that the majority of the healing talents haven’t felt important enough for most healers which caused them to go deeper into Discipline instead of Holy. The healing output should be about the same as before if not higher when Holy is talented deeper.*
>
>  **Spiritual Healing**: Healing increase has been increased from 2/4/6/8/10% to 6/12/18/24/30%
>
>  *Developer Comment: This change has been done to compensate for the baseline healing nerfs.*
content_html:
This is an odd progression indeed, but it's a deliberate change on Turtle made with CC2 from the 1.17.2 patch.
The base healing values for ranks above level 30 and Spell Power scaling for all ranks have been reduced by 15% for the following spells: Lesser Heal, Renew, Heal, Flash Heal, Prayer of Healing, Greater Heal, Desperate Prayer and Lightwell.

Developer Comment: This change has been done alongside a buff to Spiritual Healing, the introduction of Swift Recovery and updates to Lightwell making it an useful part of a healer’s toolkit. Most players have felt that the majority of the healing talents haven’t felt important enough for most healers which caused them to go deeper into Discipline instead of Holy. The healing output should be about the same as before if not higher when Holy is talented deeper.

Spiritual Healing: Healing increase has been increased from 2/4/6/8/10% to 6/12/18/24/30%

Developer Comment: This change has been done to compensate for the baseline healing nerfs.

author: Silveredmoon
subject: Feedback and Talent Suggestions for Priest Specializations
content_md:
Dear Turtle WoW Team,

First of all, I would like to express my sincere gratitude for your dedication to the game environment. Playing here truly recaptures that "first-time" magic of World of Warcraft—as we say, "we have one more world than everyone else."

Drawing from my extensive experience playing the Priest class, I have compiled some feedback and suggestions regarding the current talent directions. I hope these insights are helpful for future development.

 1. Holy Priest: Defining the "Heal-to-Full" Niche
In a raid environment, Holy Priests are versatile supports. While we may not match the specialized HOT output of Druids, the single-target efficiency of Paladins, or the group-healing utility of Shamans, the current meta often makes Holy Priests feel redundant. High mana costs and long cast times struggle to keep up with the modern raid tempo.

I am very pleased with the direction of the 1.18.1 updates. It seems the team is finally solidifying the Holy Priest's identity. To further balance us against other classes (who have received significant buffs to their traditional weaknesses), I suggest the following:

Introduction of Prayer of Mending: This skill would bridge the gap in our "proactive" healing. Providing a buff that heals upon taking damage and jumps to nearby allies would give Priests the necessary tools to maintain raid stability without being outpaced by instant-cast healers.

T3.5 Set Bonus Adjustment: To better align with the new vision, I suggest changing the 5-piece set bonus (mana cost reduction) to apply to all healing or Holy spells, rather than a specific subset. This would provide the sustained throughput needed for upcoming challenges.

 2. Shadow Priest: Leveling and Scaling
The current early-tier Shadow talents feel somewhat lackluster for a level 60 character.

Spirit Tap Improvement: Currently, this is only useful for solo leveling. I suggest modifying it so that Mind Blast critical strikes can trigger a minor version of the Spirit Tap buff. This would give the talent value in raid encounters where "killing blows" are rare.

AOE Capabilities: While our "Utility DPS" role is acceptable, the lack of any meaningful AOE makes certain encounters frustrating. If the goal is pure DPS, an AOE tool is essential; if the goal is support, our current kit is close, but still needs a slight edge in scaling.

 3. Discipline Priest: Making Spirit Meaningful
Historically, Discipline has been a "filler" tree for PvP or hybrid builds. In the Turtle WoW environment, its identity remains a bit blurry.

Spirit to Spell Power Conversion: I suggest fine-tuning the talents that convert Spirit into Spell Power/Healing. Spirit is a core Priest stat, and making this conversion more efficient would allow both Holy and Shadow Priests to better utilize their gear, creating a unique "stat-scaling" identity for the class.

Thank you for your time and for everything you do for the community. I look forward to the future of Turtle WoW!

Best regards

author: Murfo
subject: My suggestions for possible changes in 1.8.1 for Shadow Priest, if there is still time.
content_md:
The changes you are proposing for patch 1.8.1 seem very interesting and well thought out to me. However, I would like to contribute a few additional ideas.

In my opinion, I believe that Shadow Priest is still not enough fun to play in PvE gameplay. I am not referring to its DPS numbers, but rather to its damage mechanics. With that in mind, I would like to propose a few ideas to make it more enjoyable:

 **- Vampiric Embrace as a 30-minute self-buff, or at least 10 minutes.**
We already have a very clear role: healing while dealing damage. However, it is very frustrating to lose a lot of DPS time constantly applying this effect to enemies that die within a few seconds. Having to include this ability repeatedly in the rotation becomes tedious.

 **- Shadow Word: Pain and Mind Flay should start with an initial damage tick.**
I am not asking for a DPS increase through this change, as total damage could be adjusted accordingly. However, the feeling of dealing immediate damage instead of waiting 1 to 3 seconds makes a huge difference in gameplay satisfaction.

 **- An AoE ability.**
Once again, it feels frustrating to be almost useless during pulls with multiple small mobs. In my case, all I can really do is shield other casters. But applying a shield every four seconds does not help as much as being able to contribute to DPS.
Being able to cast Holy Nova in Shadowform is an interesting idea, but requiring 10 talent points in otherwise useless talents makes it non-viable.

 **- Finally, increasing the range of Mind Flay to match Mind Blast.**
Mind Flay is our main source of damage, and it is very frustrating during boss fights to constantly reposition just to cast a channeled spell with shorter range.

Thank you very much for reading my suggestions. I hope they can be taken into consideration for future changes.

Kind regards.

author: Sleeplust
subject: Unwise complication in shadow/holy-specified DPS sets in 1.18.1 update
content_md:
First of all, I pressume that 1 univeral "spell damage and healing effect" should be evaluated as more than 1 "shadow spell damage", 1 "holy spell damage" or 1 "healing effect".

In the incoming 1.18.1 update, some universal spell effect from priest sets is transform directly into shadow damage without coefficient conversion. For example, the universal "44 spell power" on Coronet of Faith is converted into "44 shadow damage", meaning that the gear and corresponding set are no longer as efficient as before for healers while its shadow damage remains (if the damage conversion rate is the same). I take that a nerf to priest sets.

If the damage converting system is so simple, new parts with only holy damage may be unnecessary, because the attributes holy or shadow priests require that need to be converted are resistance reduction, critical rate, hit rate and casting speed. At least they should make some difference in amount of universal and single school damages, or new gears would only eat up inventory space.
